svg.title: DBS relational map — Classification and lookup
svg.desc: DBS tables with exact foreign-key column connections, generated directly by the Go schema tool.
svg.text: Dataset identity, eras, tiers, types, physics groups, and branch hashes. Exact arrows run from FK source columns to referenced PK/UQ columns.
PK primary key · FK foreign key · UQ unique · NN not null · +N folded columns are in the dictionary
